tax.text: Goldman says Americans are overtaxed and has supported property, income, franchise and federal tax cuts.
tax.quote: Americans are overtaxed, and I will support any efforts to return more of their hard-earned money back to them

debt.text: Goldman said Congress would not cut Medicare or Social Security, while seeking administrative efficiencies.
debt.quote: we're not going to cut Medicaid, we're not going to cut Medicare, we're not going to cut Social Security.

schools.text: Goldman supported legislation providing public funds for private-school tuition and later backed educational savings accounts.
schools.quote: Goldman, who supported legislation that would have allowed parents to receive public money to subsidize private school tuition

safety.text: Goldman authored legislation preventing large cities from defunding police and backed mandatory incarceration for traffickers.
safety.quote: I also authored the bill to stop large cities from defunding their police departments and passed a law to combat human trafficking

immigration.text: Goldman supported state laws permitting arrests and deportations and voted for billions of dollars in border enforcement funding.
immigration.quote: I voted for the toughest border security laws of any state, including the ability to arrest and deport illegals.

guns.text: Goldman pledged to protect gun rights after supporting open carry, campus carry and permitless carry legislation.
guns.quote: As a member of Congress, I will continue to fiercely protect your Second Amendment rights and freedoms.

abortion.text: Goldman supported Texas's heartbeat abortion restriction and voted to defund abortion providers.
abortion.quote: The Texas Heartbeat bill, which I supported, stated that if a heartbeat was detected then an abortion could not occur.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Goldman voted to restrict women's collegiate sports participation according to sex at birth.
gender.quote: In 2023, I voted for the Save Women’s Sports Act, which extends that protection to women’s sports at the collegiate level.

health.text: Goldman supports retaining Medicare and Medicaid but opposes establishing additional taxpayer-funded health programs.
health.quote: C) Medicaid and Medicare should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary.

energy.text: Goldman supported restoring oil and gas leasing while repealing green-energy subsidies and mandates.
energy.quote: Restores onshore oil and gas lease sales to increase energy production

voting.text: Goldman says he passed Texas legislation targeting ballot harvesting and will continue pursuing ballot-security measures in Congress.
voting.quote: As a State Representative, I passed the strongest election integrity bill in Texas history. This legislation works to end illegal ballot harvesting
